maya: Quick follow-up after the postmortem: we're still seeing low-frequency aggregate errors and a subtle missing-span signal during compaction windows. Opening a short owner sync to lock down next steps. cc @raj @leo
raj: Can you paste the detection query you used?
maya: Sure:```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, count(*) as spans_in, count(*) FILTER (WHERE processed=TRUE) as spans_processed
FROM spans_ingest
WHERE ts > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY hr
ORDER BY hr DESC;
```
leo: I see 4 small troughs that line up with compaction windows and two pod restarts. Logs show "partial-batch-dropped" then a watermark commit shortly after.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20725 (recurring-agg-delta). Playbook: /playbooks/agg-ingest-followup.md
maya: Proposal for owners & SLAs: raj -> ETL retry + watermark guard (48h), leo -> infra canary for anti-affinity + reserved-burst pool (24h), analytics -> SLO impact calc + customer list (72h). I'll own postmortem writeup and recurrence watch setup (72h). Agree?
raj: Agree. I'll implement idempotent retry for partial batches and a guard that blocks watermark advancement while pending_batches > 0. PR behind feature flag, will canary to shard 2.
leo: Infra plan: enforce strict anti-affinity during compaction windows, add two spare nodes as burst pool, and bump etl-worker mem requests to 6Gi on canary. Ticket INF-20725.
analytics: I'll run an affected-customer query once you have canary results; will prepare a short email template if SLOs are impacted. ETA 72h.
maya: Adding action items to INC-20725:
- raj: retry + watermark guard + unit/integration tests (due +48h)
- leo: infra canary + mem bump + staging validation (due +24h)
- analytics: impact mapping + stakeholder notice (due +72h)
- maya: postmortem addendum + recurrence monitor (due +72h)
Please drop :white_check_mark: when you start and when complete.
raj: :white_check_mark: starting PR and profiler capture now (WIP at https://git.internal/etl/pull/912)
leo: :white_check_mark: infra canary scheduled for tonight. Will post results to the incident bucket.
oncall-bot: Recurrence monitor set: page on 2 recurrences within 14d. Next review scheduled 2026-10-12T11:00:00Z UTC.
maya: Thanks all 02AD I'll attach this thread and canary links to the postmortem. Closing this triage thread for now; owners update INC-20725 as you progress.
